title: Zig
description: Zig projects: the Zig compiler mounted in; GitHub open, everything else closed.

de.title: Zig
de.description: Zig-Projekte: der Zig-Compiler eingehängt; GitHub offen, alles andere zu.

notes: The Zig compiler (with its own C and C++ compiler, zig cc and zig c++) comes with the preset (--toolchain zig): from sandbox-ai's signed toolchains, mounted read-only at /opt/toolchains (nothing to install in the sandbox). Not in the store yet, the start offers to add it (sandbox-ai toolchain add zig: a download, its signature and SHA-256 checked) - on a terminal it asks, with --fix it does, the app asks in its window. Its registries are the ones this preset opens.

Packages of a build.zig.zon come from the URLs it names: GitHub is open, another host needs --allow-host NAME on the command line. Its caches are in the sandbox's HOME (~/.cache/zig) and the project (.zig-cache).
C and C++ with CMake and Ninja: the preset c-cpp.
Pushes: a login during the run (sandbox-ai net allow --git-token-env ...) or the push proxy.
